mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals a strengthening labor market, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls > 0.5pp in 1 month, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings prospects.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 50k and RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: In periods where PAYEMS rises > 50k and RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending expectations.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, when HOUST falls > 0.5% in 1 month, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals rising inflation, which may trigger Federal Reserve tightening and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% in 1 month, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to elevated corporate revenue growth.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% and RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST rises > 0.5% and RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in unemployment coupled with payroll growth (PAYEMS) signals labor market recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity improves.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.3pp and PAYEMS rises > 50k in 1 month
failure_condition: In the high-unemployment regime, when UNRATE falls > 0.3pp and PAYEMS rises > 50k in 1 month, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month growth rate in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% indicates strengthening supply chain activity, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate output expands.
failure_condition: When INDPRO 3-month growth exceeds 0.5%, SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.
